title: The Sunday Read: ‘What Rashida Tlaib Represents’

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍贵的藏品去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满美感的、有50年历史的古董移动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在，请在您喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: My name is Rosina Ali.
sentences.zh: 我是罗西娜·阿里。

sentences.en: I'm a contributing writer to The New York Times Magazine and I'm sharing a profile I've wrote recently of Representative Rashida Tlaib.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人，我将分享我最近为众议员拉希达·特莱布写的人物特写。

sentences.en: Representative Tlaib is a democratic socialist who was born and raised in southwest Detroit.
sentences.zh: 特莱布议员是一位民主社会主义者，在底特律西南部出生并长大。

sentences.en: In 2018, she became the first Palestinian-American woman ever elected to the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 2018年，她成为历史上第一位当选美国众议院议员的巴勒斯坦裔美国女性。

sentences.en: I want you to know my mom, who's from a small village in the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 我想让你认识我的妈妈，她来自约旦河西岸的一个小村庄。

sentences.en: They're literally glued.
sentences.zh: 他们简直是黏住了。

sentences.en: It's like 5 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 差不多五点钟。

sentences.en: It's like 6 o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 就像早上六点钟一样。

sentences.en: And now it's more than that.
sentences.zh: 而现在不仅如此。

sentences.en: But they're glued to the TV.
sentences.zh: 但他们紧盯着电视。

sentences.en: My grandmother, my aunts, my uncles in Palestine are sitting back and watching their granddaughters.
sentences.zh: 我在巴勒斯坦的祖母、阿姨、叔叔们正坐着看他们的孙女们。

sentences.en: When Tlaib started as a state representative in 2008, her whole thing was the environment and immigrant rights.
sentences.zh: 2008年特莱布刚开始担任州众议员时，她一门心思关注的是环境和移民权利。

sentences.en: At the time, she didn't really have a clear policy agenda when it came to Israel-Palestine because she'd been so focused on domestic politics and her Detroit community.
sentences.zh: 当时，她在以色列和巴勒斯坦问题上并没有真正清晰的政策议程，因为她此前一直专注于国内政治和她的底特律社区。

sentences.en: But once she got to D.C., she found herself forced to talk about this issue and really hone her position.
sentences.zh: 但一旦到了华盛顿，她发现自己被迫谈论这个议题，并真正磨练自己的立场。

sentences.en: Tlaib doesn't view the Palestinian-Israeli conflict through a foreign policy lens.
sentences.zh: 特莱布并不通过外交政策的镜头来看待巴以冲突。

sentences.en: Instead, she really views it through a lens of equality and justice.
sentences.zh: 相反，她真正通过平等和正义的视角来看待它。

sentences.en: And she sees a lot of parallels between Detroit and Palestine.
sentences.zh: 她看到了底特律和巴勒斯坦之间的许多相似之处。

sentences.en: Tlaib was, and still is, wary of being the only Palestinian voice in the room.
sentences.zh: 特莱布过去是，现在仍然对成为房间里唯一的巴勒斯坦声音保持警惕。

sentences.en: She's gotten death threats.
sentences.zh: 她收到过死亡威胁。

sentences.en: Threats that seem to go up every time she's mentioned on Fox News.
sentences.zh: 这些威胁似乎每当她在福克斯新闻上被提及就会增加。

sentences.en: Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib.
sentences.zh: 国会女议员拉希达·特莱布。

sentences.zh: 民主党国会女议员拉希达·特莱布。

sentences.zh: 拉希达·特莱布。

sentences.zh: 拉希达·特莱布。

sentences.en: The always angry, perpetual victim, Rashida Tlaib.
sentences.zh: 那个总是愤怒、永远的受害者，拉希达·特莱布。

sentences.en: Tlaib, who is a Palestinian-American.
sentences.zh: 特莱布是一位巴勒斯坦裔美国人。

sentences.en: She has been an outspoken critic of U.S.
sentences.zh: 她一直是美国对以色列政策的

sentences.en: policy toward Israel.
sentences.zh: 直言不讳的批评者。

sentences.en: Rashida Tlaib is denouncing Israel for trying to silence her voice.
sentences.zh: 拉希达·特莱布正在谴责以色列试图让她闭嘴。

sentences.en: Representative Tlaib and Representative Omar, who are basically anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 特莱布议员和奥马尔议员，他们基本上是反犹太的。

sentences.en: Is full-blown Islamist propaganda.
sentences.zh: 这是彻头彻尾的伊斯兰主义宣传。

sentences.en: It's not any kind of fantasy that Rashida Tlaib thinks that the Holocaust was a good thing.
sentences.zh: 拉希达·特莱布认为大屠杀是一件好事，这绝不是什么幻想。

sentences.en: It's been 20 years since 9-11, but we still live in a country with prevalent anti-Muslim beliefs.
sentences.zh: 距离9·11事件已经过去20年了，但我们仍然生活在一个反穆斯林信仰普遍存在的国家。

sentences.en: Tlaib even told me that she wasn't prepared for just how Islamophobic Congress could be.
sentences.zh: 特莱布甚至告诉我，她没有准备好面对国会中的反伊斯兰情绪会如此严重。

sentences.en: But the fact that she tries to humanize the Palestinian rights movement, really, I think,
sentences.zh: 但她试图将巴勒斯坦人权运动人性化的事实，实际上，我认为，

sentences.en: quietly pushes against a type of Islamophobia that's been historically tied to anti-Palestinian sentiment.
sentences.zh: 悄悄地反击了一种历史上与反巴勒斯坦情绪挂钩的伊斯兰恐惧症。

sentences.en: My story is about the tension that Tlaib faces between wanting to serve her district, which is the second poorest district in the country,
sentences.zh: 我的故事讲述了特莱布所面临的张力：一方面她想要服务她的选区——该国第二贫困的选区，

sentences.en: and having to navigate this controversial landscape of Palestinian and Israeli politics, and how all that might play out in such a politically divisive election year.
sentences.zh: 另一方面又不得不驾驭巴勒斯坦和以色列政治这片充满争议的景观，以及这一切如何在如此一个政治分裂的选举年中发挥作用。

sentences.en: So here's what Rashida Tlaib represents.
sentences.zh: 这就是拉希达·特莱布所代表的。

sentences.zh: 由孙尼拉·南卡尼朗读。

sentences.en: Last May, following protests in East Jerusalem over planned evictions of Palestinians,
sentences.zh: 去年五月，在东耶路撒冷爆发针对驱逐巴勒斯坦人计划的抗议活动之后，

sentences.en: Hamas started firing rockets toward Tel Aviv, and Israeli airstrikes pounded residential buildings in the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯开始向特拉维夫发射火箭弹，以色列的空袭则猛烈轰炸了加沙地带的住宅楼。

sentences.en: Shortly after, a group of nine Democratic lawmakers, all long-standing Israel supporters, took to the floor of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，由九名民主党议员组成的小组——他们都是长期支持以色列的人士——走上美国

sentences.en: House of Representatives to reaffirm the country's right to defend itself.
sentences.zh: 众议院发言，重申该国进行自我防卫的权利。

sentences.en: We have a duty as Americans to stand by the side of Israel in the face of attacks from terrorists,
sentences.zh: 作为美国人，面对恐怖分子的袭击，我们有责任站在以色列一边，

sentences.en: Elaine Luria, a representative from Virginia, said, who again have the same goal in mind, to kill Jews.
sentences.zh: 来自弗吉尼亚州的众议员伊莱恩·卢里亚说，这些人再次有着共同的目标，即杀死犹太人。

sentences.en: Later that evening, about a dozen other Democrats spoke as well, to question the justice of funneling almost $4 billion a year
sentences.zh: 那天晚上晚些时候，大约十几位其他民主党人也发表了讲话，质疑将每年近40亿美元源源不断输送给

sentences.en: to a country that was in the midst of bombing civilians.
sentences.zh: 一个正在轰炸平民的国家的正义性。

sentences.en: Do Palestinians have a right to survive?
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦人有生存的权利吗？

sentences.en: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, the New York Democrat, said.
sentences.zh: 纽约民主党人亚历山德里亚·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯说。
zh_words: 亚历山德里亚·奥卡西奥

sentences.en: Do we believe that?
sentences.zh: 我们相信这一点吗？

sentences.en: And if so, we have a responsibility to that as well.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，我们对此也负有责任。

sentences.en: The speeches were a rare occasion when Palestinian rights have been addressed at such length on the House floor.
sentences.zh: 这些演讲是巴勒斯坦人权问题罕见地在众议院获得如此长时间讨论的场合。

sentences.en: They were introduced by Representative Mark Pocan of Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 它们由来自威斯康星州的众议员马克·波坎引入。

sentences.en: But the driving message of the session came from Rashida Tlaib, the 45-year-old second-term congresswoman from Detroit,
sentences.zh: 但此次会议的核心信息来自于拉希达·特莱布，这位45岁、来自底特律的连任两届的国会女议员，

sentences.en: who, according to several people familiar with the discussions, played a significant role in making the speeches happen.
sentences.zh: 据几位熟悉讨论情况的人士透露，她在促成这些演讲方面发挥了重要作用。

sentences.en: How many Palestinians have to die for their lives to matter?
sentences.zh: 究竟有多少巴勒斯坦人死去，他们的生命才算重要？

sentences.en: Tlaib said in her own remarks, fighting back tears.
sentences.zh: 特莱布在自己的发言中强忍着泪水说道。

sentences.en: Tlaib is the only Palestinian-American now serving in the House of Representatives, and the first with family currently living in the West Bank,
sentences.zh: 特莱布是目前众议院中唯一的巴勒斯坦裔美国人，也是第一位有家人目前生活在约旦河西岸的议员，

sentences.en: whose three million inhabitants' lives are intimately shaped by American support for Israel.
sentences.zh: 那里的三百万居民的生活深受美国对以色列支持的塑造。

sentences.en: As the May fighting intensified, colleagues approached Tlaib to ask if her family was safe.
sentences.zh: 随着五月份冲突的加剧，同事们走近特莱布，询问她的家人是否安全。

sentences.en: It's a voice that hasn't been heard before,
sentences.zh: 这是一个从未被听到过的声音，

sentences.en: Betty McCollum, a Democratic representative from Minnesota, told me.
sentences.zh: 来自明尼苏达州的民主党众议员贝蒂·麦科勒姆告诉我。

sentences.en: Tlaib has been criticized, sometimes viciously, by Republicans and pro-Israel Democrats for calling Israel an apartheid regime,
sentences.zh: 特莱布因称以色列为种族隔离政权，以及支持旨在通过对以色列施加经济压力来结束军事占领的“抵制、撤资、制裁”运动，而遭到共和党人和亲以色列民主党人的批评，有时甚至是恶毒的批评。

sentences.en: and for her support of the Boycott, Divestment, and Sanctions movement, which aims to end military occupation by exerting economic pressure on Israel.
sentences.zh: 她因对以色列政策的批评而被指责为反犹太人，并成为了福克斯新闻青睐的靶子。

sentences.en: She has been called anti-Semitic for her criticism of Israeli policies and has become a favored quarry of Fox News.
sentences.zh: 她因对以色列政策的批评而被指责为反犹太人，并成为了福克斯新闻青睐的靶子。

sentences.en: Tony Paris, a close friend and former colleague of Tlaib's, told me that in conversations with some of his relatives, conservative Democrats,
sentences.zh: 特莱布的密友兼前同事托尼·帕里斯告诉我，在与他的一些亲戚——保守派民主党人的交谈中，

sentences.en: he has tiptoed around the Rashida thing.
sentences.zh: 他一直在“拉希达”这件事上小心翼翼。

sentences.en: But Tlaib's arrival on the national stage has also coincided with an opening, albeit a small one, within the Democratic Party, to challenge the United States-Israel policy.
sentences.zh: 但特莱布登上国家舞台也恰逢民主党内部出现了一个缝隙——尽管很小——开始挑战美国对以色列政策。

sentences.en: The Palestinian cause has become a significant part of the politics of the American left, at the same time that the left has gained a legible footing on the national stage.
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦事业已成为美国左翼政治的重要组成部分，与此同时左翼也在国家舞台上获得了明显的立足点。

sentences.en: Tlaib, a Democratic socialist, who is, if anything, more outspoken on domestic issues than she is on the Palestinian cause, has found herself at the center of this turn.
sentences.zh: 特莱布是一位民主社会主义者，比起巴勒斯坦事业，她在国内议题上往往更加直言不讳，她发现自己处于这一转变的中心。

sentences.en: She appeared in a traditional Palestinian dress made by her mother during her swearing-in.
sentences.zh: 她在宣誓就职时穿着一件由母亲制作的传统巴勒斯坦长袍。

sentences.en: Sometimes wears a kafia, symbolically tied to the Palestinian resistance, on the house floor, and speaks often about her grandmother in the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 有时在众议院戴着象征巴勒斯坦抵抗运动的头巾，并经常谈论她在约旦河西岸的祖母。

sentences.en: Rebecca Abu Shdeid, a lawyer and longtime Arab-American activist, told me that the simple fact of Tlaib's presence on the hill means that we are now actual people to them.
sentences.zh: 律师兼长期阿拉伯裔美国人活动家丽贝卡·阿布·施代德告诉我，特莱布在国会山出现这一简单事实意味着我们对他们来说是真实的人了。

sentences.en: Yet Tlaib is wary of adopting the role of the only Palestinian voice in the room.
sentences.zh: 然而，特莱布对扮演房间里唯一的巴勒斯坦声音这一角色保持警惕。

sentences.en: I feel like no one wants to see me as anyone but Palestinian, she told me.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，我觉得除了巴勒斯坦人，没人想把我当成别的任何人。

sentences.en: I'm a mother.
sentences.zh: 我是一位母亲。

sentences.en: I'm a woman.
sentences.zh: 我是一个女人。

sentences.en: I have gone through a lot, being the daughter of two immigrants in the United States.
sentences.zh: 作为美国两个移民的女儿，我经历了很多。

sentences.en: I'm also the big sister of 13 younger siblings.
sentences.zh: 我也是13个弟弟妹妹的大姐。

sentences.en: I'm also a neighbor in a predominantly black city.
sentences.zh: 我也是一个以黑人为主的城市的邻居。

sentences.en: Tlaib's pitch is that the roads to a fairer Israel policy and to fix the problems that plague her district, poverty, water access, pollution, are not so different.
sentences.zh: 特莱布的观点是，通往更公平的以色列政策之路与解决困扰她选区的问题（如贫困、水资源获取、污染）之路并没有太大不同。

sentences.en: She didn't run for Congress with a strategic plan to shift the Israeli-Palestinian debate or even a coherent vision to do so.
sentences.zh: 她竞选国会议员时并没有带着改变巴以辩论的战略计划，甚至没有一个连贯的愿景来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Sometimes she even seemed to equivocate.
sentences.zh: 有时她甚至显得含糊其辞。

sentences.en: We need to be not choosing a side, she told the Washington Post during her 2018 campaign.
sentences.zh: 我们在2018年竞选期间告诉《华盛顿邮报》，我们需要不选边站队。

sentences.en: But over her three years in Washington,
sentences.zh: 但在华盛顿的三年里，

sentences.en: Tlaib's argument has sharpened.
sentences.zh: 特莱布的论点变得更加尖锐。

sentences.en: If the United States cares about democratic values, then upholding Palestinian rights is inherently American.
sentences.zh: 如果美国关心民主价值，那么捍卫巴勒斯坦人权就是天经地义的美国精神。

sentences.en: I first met Tlaib last summer at a cafe in the Midtown neighborhood of Detroit, a gentrifying area of dive bars and boutiques.
sentences.zh: 我去年夏天在底特律中城区的一家咖啡馆第一次见到特莱布，这是一个正在绅士化的酒吧和精品店聚集区。

sentences.en: Two days of thunderstorms had left 850,000 people without power, and several restaurants were still closed.
sentences.zh: 两天的雷暴天气导致85万人断电，几家餐厅仍然关门歇业。

sentences.en: Tlaib was in a white summer dress and sneakers.
sentences.zh: 特莱布穿着一件白色夏裙和运动鞋。

sentences.en: My mother hates when I wear them.
sentences.zh: 我母亲讨厌我穿它们。

sentences.en: A congressional pin hung around her neck.
sentences.zh: 一个国会议员徽章挂在她的脖子上。

sentences.en: I had ambitiously ordered a cinnamon roll, and as we sat down,
sentences.zh: 我雄心勃勃地点了一个肉桂卷，当我们坐下时，

sentences.en: Tlaib, who had gotten a coffee, eyed it and brought me a fork and napkins.
sentences.zh: 要了咖啡的特莱布看了看它，给我拿了一把叉子和餐巾纸。

sentences.en: I'm such a mom, she said.
sentences.zh: 我真是个操心的妈，她说。

sentences.en: Shortly after they arrived in Washington,
sentences.zh: 他们到达华盛顿后不久，

sentences.en: Ilhan Omar, a Democratic representative from Minnesota, gave bracelets to fellow members of The Squad.
sentences.zh: 来自明尼苏达州的民主党众议员伊尔汉·奥马尔向“小分队”的其他成员赠送了手链。

sentences.en: The young, left-leaning Congress members of color that at the time included Tlaib, Omar,
sentences.zh: 这个年轻的、倾向左翼的有色人种国会议员群体当时包括特莱布、奥马尔、

sentences.en: Ocasio-Cortez, and Ayanna Pressley of Massachusetts, all of whom were elected in 2018.
sentences.zh: 奥卡西奥-科尔特斯以及来自马萨诸塞州的阿亚娜·普雷斯利，他们都是在2018年当选的。

sentences.en: Omar had Tlaib's inscribed Mama Bear.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔在特莱布的手链上刻上了“妈妈熊”。

sentences.en: Tlaib grew up caring for her seven brothers and six sisters, balancing diapers with homework.
sentences.zh: 特莱布在照顾七个兄弟和六个姐妹长大，在换尿布和做家庭作业之间寻找平衡。

sentences.en: Her father, Harbi el-Abid, was born in East Jerusalem, and her mother, Fatima, grew up in Beit al-Al-Foka, a village in the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲哈尔比·阿比德出生在东耶路撒冷，她的母亲法蒂玛在约旦河西岸的一个村庄拜特阿尔富卡长大。

sentences.en: They arrived in Detroit shortly before Tlaib was born in 1976,
sentences.zh: 他们在1976年特莱布出生前不久抵达底特律，

sentences.en: as the city was reeling from years of deindustrialization and redlining, and the deadly unrest of 1967.
